free_tier.stated: On the no-cost Spark plan, Hosting storage is free up to 10 GB and CDN data transfer is free up to 10 GB a month, with a 2 GB ceiling on any single file. Over either limit without the Blaze plan, deployment stops or the sites are disabled until the month turns.

egress.terms: 'Data transfer from the CDN to your end users is at no cost up to 10 GB/month'; past it there is a short grace period and then sites are disabled until the start of the next month, quoted

interface_detail: inferred from the tooling the provider documents; not probed
chaining: 10 GB stored and 10 GB a month served is a documentation site or a demo, not a data host; it composes as the front door for a project whose real artefacts sit in a bucket with a larger allowance.

limits.value: 10 GB a month of CDN transfer is the smaller of the two: at 10 GB stored and 10 GB served, the allowance is spent by serving the whole site once a month.

limits_note: 10 GB a month of CDN transfer is the smaller of the two: at 10 GB stored and 10 GB served, the allowance is spent by serving the whole site once a month.
